title: Chapter 10 Food Crisis
content:
Chapter 10 Food Crisis

Seeing that the chaotic scene in the field calmed down quietly, Zhong Yu's majestic eyes swept down, and all the people who were swept by the eyes lowered their heads and did not dare to look at them, as if they were some kind of beast.

After a glance, Zhong Yu nodded with satisfaction, it seemed that his majesty was pretty good, and no one dared to defy him in front of him.

"Cough! Cough!" These two coughs came from Zhong Yu's throat, which seemed to clear his dry throat, and also seemed to remind the people below that my lord is about to speak, and all those who are sensible should listen carefully to me. and pricked up his ears.

Sure enough, when they heard the coughing sound, the people below shuddered, their ears perked up, and they lowered their heads solemnly, waiting for Zhong Yu's lecture.

Seeing the following reaction, Zhong Yu didn't talk nonsense, and said directly: "I don't want to talk nonsense with you, I just want to prove a problem with you, that is, you are indeed what I got, as for the method, I don't want to tell you !"

"Also, this is my territory. Since you got it from me and you are standing on my territory, if you don't want to suffer any serious consequences, then keep my words in your heart and follow my arrangements. As long as you do well, I will give you fields and land, so that you can live and work in peace and contentment here."

Hearing Zhong Yu's words, there was a commotion among the people below, and the buzzing sounded. Zhong Yu waited for a while, as if giving them some time to calm down.

"Okay, shut up, have you forgotten what I said just now? How dare you be so undisciplined and want to be punished by my lord?" Zhong Yu saw the people below, and saw that he didn't care about them, but made a noise The sound is getting louder and louder.

Sure enough, hearing Zhong Yu's loud shout, the people below suddenly became quiet. It seems that the Chinese people are still quite afraid of those who are officials. This is engraved in the bones and can't be changed. After all It has a history of five thousand years.

"Since you have come to this place, don't think too much. You can't go back, and I'm not afraid to tell you that this is not the original world, but another world."

After finishing speaking, Zhong Yu ignored their reaction and left, returned to the mansion, and then arranged for Wang Daniu to escort them, and divided them into several groups to focus on escorting them.

And count the concentrated population, how many males are there? How many are women? How old are you? How old are you? How many children? Report to you at that time.

The sun is high, the sun is shining, and the body is warm, so that in this early spring season, some cold breezes have also been dissipated, bringing a trace of warmth.

An hour passed like this. Wang Daniu took the population and household registration he sorted out, and took the front of Zhong Yu's case, and then reported some situations. Zhong Yu asked him to retire and thought quietly.

For the first time, the population of the refugee camp was quite large, about 271 people, including about 115 strong men between the ages of 15 and 45, about 100 strong women between the ages of 15 and 40, and the rest. There are more than 50 people, all of them are old people or children. They are not very useful for the time being, but they are used to enrich the population and cultivate those strong women. The sense of belonging to the territory is also quite good. In general, It was a good talk this time.

After counting the specific population, Zhong Yu asked Wang Daniu to organize and borrow those refugees into households according to their closeness, blood relationship, and start their own families. Then, organize them and strive to build several rooms per household within two or three days. Wooden houses, each to form a new family and live in it.

After some hectic arrangements, Zhong Yu finally had time to sit in the study, quietly thinking about his gains during this period of time.

First of all, the population of his current territory has reached 602 people, of which the number of males is about 265. Among them, there are about 231 females. There are more than 100 old and weak women and children left. The sub-borrowed households were divided into households, and the households were organized into Qimin households. About 190 households were established, including 163 households and about 30 slave households (the tribal prisoners who attacked those barbarians before, except for some credits, were exempted from their families and family members. If you have your own slaves, other people will be demoted to slaves, and you can't get rid of them unless you get credit.)

Secondly, the regular soldiers here include the Yellow Turban Army, 39 soldiers, 30 slave soldiers, 50 servant soldiers, and the servant army consists of those soldiers who were released from slaves by meritorious service, and some soldiers who were not suitable were excluded. Old and weak, injured? What kind of a natural disability or something? Eliminate all.

After streamlining, the fifty most brave men were selected to form a servant army. As a result, although the number of soldiers was much smaller, the combat effectiveness was greatly enhanced.

The second is food. Adult men need about 1.2 jin of food a day, women 1 jin, and children and the elderly, about 0.8 jin. In this way, a family of three consumes about 3 jin of food per day.

Today, the population of the territory is about 200 households. In this way, the daily food consumption is about 600 catties, which is six stone. (Note, 100 pounds is equal to 1 stone)

After so many days of consumption, in the past few days, about 30 stone of food had been consumed. There are 970 shi left, and with today's population, that food can last about 160 days.

The current population of the territory will definitely not stop, and will continue to increase, probably to 1,000 households, and the consumption of food will increase greatly.

1,000 households consume about 30 dans of grain a day, and with the current 960 shi of grain in the territory, it can only support one month.

It's early spring, and it's just a good time to plant food, but even if it is to plant food, it will take about four months to harvest, and there are still three months of food shortages, so how to spend it!

It's really a headache. With such a big food shortage, where can I find it? Zhong Yu had a splitting headache thinking about it, and his head was about to explode.

Suddenly, a flash of inspiration, and finally a thought flashed in my mind, yes! Luck value, with enough Luck value, you can exchange food with the system!

Then how to get the luck value, war, there is nothing wrong, it is war, if you get a larger territory and population, you can get more luck value.

According to the rules of the system, every 50 people in a month can provide a point of luck value, calculated according to the population, that is to say, ten households and fifty people in a mile can produce a point of luck value.

One pavilion with one hundred households and five hundred people can produce 10 points of luck; a township with 5,000 households and five thousand people can produce 100 points of luck.

According to the exchange of the system, one point of luck can be exchanged for ten stone grains. If you own this month, you can increase the population of the territory to 1,000 households and 5,000 people.

Then every month's food can be exchanged with the system's air transport value, and you don't have to worry about food. And I only need to use three months of lucky points, plus this month's food, to support the harvest of the spring planted food.

And if you are promoted to a township-level territory, you can also get a chance to draw a big gift package. At that time, you should be able to draw something to help yourself through the difficulties!

Thinking like this, Zhong Yu's heart slowly relaxed, and the smile on his face slowly appeared. He took a breath and slowly walked out of the study and went for a walk in the back garden.
